Ordinal read (marker unresolved): S1 (CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r6 + BEHENTRIMONIUM METHOSULFATE r9), S2 and S3 (ISOPROPYL PALMITATE r4, sunflower oil r7, soy oil r13) would all fire, i.e. the `high` pattern — but an unresolved marker is a material counter-signal and caps `high` at `moderate` (§9.1). E2 ceiling: formula-only comparative potential; concentration, dose and finished-product efficacy are not established.
